record.one_liner: Cloud helpdesk/customer support platform with a REST API for tickets, contacts, companies, and agent workflows.
record.auth_notes: Freshdesk API v2 uses a personal API key as the username in HTTP Basic Auth (Base64-encoded, dummy password), generated from the agent's Support Portal profile settings. No OAuth2 flow required for core REST API.
record.access_notes: Signing up instantly grants a 14-day Enterprise-plan trial account, from which an API key can be generated immediately (Profile Settings page) with no admin approval step. Paid plans raise rate limits (Blossom/Garden: 3,000 calls/hour; Estate/Forest: 5,000 calls/hour) while trial accounts get 50 calls/minute by default.
record.api_breadth_basis: Developer docs list 20+ resource families: Tickets, Conversations, Contacts, Agents, Companies, Groups, Ticket/Contact/Company Fields, Roles, Products, Email Configs, Solutions (KB), Discussions, Canned Responses, Time Entries, Business Hours, SLA Policies, Automations, Scenario Automations, Customer Satisfaction, Custom Objects, Field Service Management, Omnichannel Activities.
record.blocker_notes: The core REST API (the basis for building a toolkit) is available to any self-serve trial or paid account via API key with no approval gate. A separate first-party MCP integration exists but is EAP/Beta, restricted to Enterprise-plan customers who must contact their TAM or support@freshdesk.com for access — that gate applies only to the MCP wrapper, not to the underlying REST API a toolkit would use.
